services.best_for: Photographers, designers and video editors; most people only need one app or the Photography plan.
tips: The Photography plan (9.99) includes Photoshop and Lightroom, cheaper than Photoshop alone (2.99).
If you only edit PDFs, Acrobat Standard (4.99) may be enough.
New subscribers can cancel within 14 days for a full refund.
